Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets an AI assistant discover and use tools from a server. Browse a card, review its capabilities and data access, then copy a live server's configuration into an MCP-compatible client.

This catalogue includes one live, read-only brand reference server. The Water Care tools are proposed examples; saving a card does not install a server or grant access.
